This method returns a list of records from a calling list associated with a campaign.

Records are referenced by indexes, assigned to each record in the list in sequential order of insertion (beginning from 0). All records with an index greater than or equal to the requested record index, fromIndex, are returned in the response.

Note: The returned recordset contains JSON objects sorted by the index field. List Record JSON Object has two sub-objects, entry and status, defined as follows:

entry

This method returns a copy of one or more existing records in a calling list. The search for the records is performed based on the defined key fields.

Note: Time and date field values are returned in UTC format.

Note: If a PHONE type field is defined as a key, the record value is checked for a full match with the value stored in the database or the original source (if the data was modified upon loading into the database).

This method updates fields in existing records of a calling list and returns the number of successfully updated records.

Note: Manipulating the content of calling lists requires the user to have an additional "Update content of calling list" privilege.

This method catches and displays the following errors (if any were encountered during the request execution):

limitExceeded - the maximum total number of rows across all existing lists has been reached

missingKey - one or more key field values

This method adds a single new record to a calling list.

Before the record is added, the uniqueness of its key values is checked against the contents of the list. If the list does not already have a record with the specified key values, the new record is added successfully.

Note: Manipulating the content of calling lists requires the user to have an additional "Update content of calling list" privilege.

This method deletes records from a list and returns the number of successfully deleted records.

Note: Manipulating the content of calling lists requires the user to have an additional "Update content of calling list" privilege.

Records are searched for by one or many criteria defined in correspondence with the associated list fields. At least one of the available filtering criteria has to be specified. Otherwise, no record is deleted.

The method supports filtering records by:

key and searcha

This method removes a record from a list and all associated campaign results. The search for the record is performed based on the defined key fields. An error is returned if a record does not exist.

Note: Manipulating the content of calling lists requires the user to have an additional "Update content of calling list" privilege.
